summary_en: Azbil authorized acquisition of up to 15 million shares (3.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥15.0 billion via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to January 27, 2027. Previously acquired 13.1 million shares and newly acquired shares under this authorization will be cancelled on February 26, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Decision on Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Azbil Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 15 million shares of its common stock, representing 3.0% of shares outstanding (505.6 million shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥15.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 11, 2026 through January 27, 2027.

The Company stated that the share repurchase aims to improve capital efficiency while maintaining flexibility to respond to changes in the business environment. By incorporating performance trends and prospects into its capital allocation decisions, the Company seeks to enhance shareholder returns and execute nimble capital policies suited to evolving circumstances.

Cancellation of all treasury shares is scheduled for February 26, 2027, encompassing both the 13.09 million shares previously acquired pursuant to the Board resolution of May 13, 2026, and all shares to be acquired under the current authorization.
